content.text: Hey Alice, can you help me?
Of course! I'd be happy to help. What do you need assistance with today?
Can you explain how machine learning works?

Sure! At its core, machine learning is about teaching computers to learn patterns from data rather than explicitly programming every rule. Imagine showing a child thousands of pictures of cats and dogs - eventually they learn to tell them apart. ML works similarly: we feed algorithms lots of examples, and they learn to recognize patterns and make predictions. Would you like me to dive deeper into any specific aspect?
